body:
The frozen unmatched queue contains the raw label `Na` in six CultureMech recipe occurrences. Every occurrence is tagged `extracted_from_notes`; each complete recipe note names `pH buffer: Na-sesquicarbonate`. These are truncated source tokens, not evidence for elemental sodium or sodium-ion ingredient identities.

The current upstream parser is still reproducible at CultureMech `199cd9191881e8e929cd95ea0ed13aabe388e58c`: [extract_ph_buffers](https://github.com/CultureBotAI/CultureMech/blob/199cd9191881e8e929cd95ea0ed13aabe388e58c/scripts/cleanup_recipe_ingredients.py#L157) uses a character class that stops at the hyphen. Running that exact function from the live GitHub source capture against copies of all six frozen recipe notes emits only `Na`. Its Git blob is `6b19e990d36f920145f1fb802ee69425f9e570ba`. No source file was changed during this read-only reproduction.

Affected frozen source files:

- `data/normalized_yaml/bacterial/KOMODO_1063_MICROCELLA_ALKALIPHILA_medium.yaml`
- `data/normalized_yaml/bacterial/medium_220_modified_for_dsm_13870.yaml`
- `data/normalized_yaml/bacterial/medium_372_modified_for_dsm_18494.yaml`
- `data/normalized_yaml/bacterial/medium_372_modified_for_dsm_18495.yaml`
- `data/normalized_yaml/bacterial/medium_830_modified_for_dsm_21670.yaml`
- `data/normalized_yaml/bacterial/medium_86_modified_for_dsm_19627.yaml`

Worker08 case `CM_NAME:6987456ddf2caf9d7981c8970484d0b2873d088bd56eaf9c50dcebfaf50070ab` retains all six occurrence IDs and classifies the token as malformed source extraction, with no MIM owner proposal. Durable source hashes and the reproduction are under `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-08/review-history/na-extractor-reproduction.json` on `review/all-unmatched-w08-source-review-20261107` (publication pending).

Follow-up: repair the upstream note extractor so hyphenated buffer names retain their complete source scope, review the six affected occurrences against the original KOMODO/DSMZ formulation, and regenerate the normalized source rows in CultureMech's own authorized workflow. Preserve original labels and provenance; do not automatically turn the bare buffer name into a particular stock composition. MIM should keep this source token unresolved as an ingredient until the corrected source is admitted.

Acceptance: a regression invokes the actual extractor on these source notes and cannot emit an elemental `Na` ingredient; all six occurrence corrections are accounted for, and no alias or identity for sodium metal/ion is introduced by this repair. Native source and downstream mapping gates must run in the eventual integration task.

Deduplication checked live all-state searches for `sesquicarbonate` and `extract_ph_buffers` in MIM and `sesquicarbonate`/`pH buffer` in CultureMech. CultureMech #273 concerns a different preparation-sentence artifact, #299 malformed NBRC tables, and #408 volume-to-mass units. This issue tracks the exact downstream source-token hold and the parser cause, not those other repairs. This worker cannot edit the read-only CultureMech checkout or rebuild downstream data.
title: Preserve the source hold for Na truncated from Na-sesquicarbonate buffer notes
